mapping.name: Vibramail, 1 use
mapping.effects:
A full suit of armor made of long metal bars running horizontally (2 armor, _bulky_).

Moving in the armor causes the bars to knock together and vibrate, creating pleasant, resonant, and decidedly un-stealthy musical tones. When the wearer is reduced to 0 STR, all of the bars activate, vibrating and ringing out. This lasts until the sustained tone of the mail builds to a deafening level and the bars shatter, about a minute or so. They then die normally.

mapping.name: Ammonite Snorkel
mapping.effects:
A wooden tube curving at the end into a mouthpiece, with inlaid onyx spirals running along its length.

Breating into the tube causes the holder to vanish from their current location and find themselves snorkeling beneath the surface of a deep but narrow pool at the bottom of a crystal shaft. Through a faint blue light discern a massive ammonite sleeping in the center of the pool.

For the first round, there is a 1 in 10 chance of the ammonite waking and immediately devouring the PC. For each successive round this chance increases to 1 in 8, then 1 in 6, then 1 in 4.

The PC may return to their previous location by blowing sharply through the snorkel three times.

mapping.name: Light Show
mapping.description: You control a dazzling display of light and color.

mapping.name: Lightning Strike
mapping.description: Electricity flings from your fingertips doing 1d12 damage (blast) in a line.

mapping.name: Linguist
mapping.description: For the next hour you can speak and understand any mundane language.

mapping.name: Magic Seal
mapping.description: Magically locks a door, portal or chest.

mapping.name: Major Genesis
mapping.description: Creates an object of nonliving stone or metal no greater than 5 cubic foot in size.

mapping.name: Maker
mapping.description: Transforms raw materials into finished items.

mapping.name: Manic Fury
mapping.description: A target's attacks are enhanced. They must make a WIL save after a successful killing or lose control, attacking anyone in sight.

mapping.name: Masquerade
mapping.description: You assume the likeness of a similar creature you have seen.

mapping.name: Master Undead
mapping.description: Undead creatures obey your command. Intelligent undead make a WIL save.

mapping.name: Mental Tripwire
mapping.description: Intruders set off an alarm audible only to you.

mapping.name: Mind Bond
mapping.description: Two allies can communicate via a mental link for the rest of the day.

mapping.name: Mind Reader
mapping.description: You can see or hear any person you have met before.

mapping.name: Miniaturize
mapping.description: An object shrinks to one tenth its size.

mapping.name: Minor Aegis
mapping.description: A target you touch ignores the next instance of harm from a specific source.

mapping.name: Minor Genesis
mapping.description: Creates an object of nonliving matter no greater than one cubic foot in size.

mapping.name: Mirage
mapping.description: You summon a noiseless & simple illusion of your choice.

mapping.name: Molasses Veins
mapping.description: A single target moves at half speed.

mapping.name: Murky Bubble
mapping.description: You create a bubble supernatural shadow within a 20ft radius.

mapping.name: Necrotic Touch
mapping.description: Target must DEX save or is paralyzed.

mapping.name: Obfuscate
mapping.description: Target cannot be observed either through divination or scrying.

mapping.name: Obfuscation
mapping.description: Changes your appearance.

mapping.name: Obscuring Mist
mapping.description: A rolling fog obscures vision in a 300ft radius.

mapping.name: Opaque Cover
mapping.description: Details about your person become obscured and unmemorable.

mapping.name: Orb of Ignus
mapping.description: You control a floating ball of fire (1d8 damage) for a short while.

mapping.name: Orb of Immortality
mapping.description: Mundane attacks cannot harm anyone within a 10ft radius, or vice-versa.

mapping.name: Otherwordly Pet
mapping.description: Summons an unintelligent extraplanar creature up to the size of a small dog. It holds no loyalty towards you or your allies.

mapping.name: Otherworldly Gate
mapping.description: Opens a portal to another reality. It works in both directions.

mapping.name: Paincurrent
mapping.description: An arc of electricity passes from your fingertips to a target you touch. They take 1d8 damage (1d12 if wearing metal armor).

mapping.name: Passage
mapping.description: Creates a temporary path through wood, stone or brick.

mapping.name: Passive Invisibility
mapping.description: Target is invisible until they attempt harm.

mapping.name: Peeping Warlock
mapping.description: You control a pair of floating eyes so long as yours remain closed.

mapping.name: Perfect Illusion
mapping.description: Creates an image with sound, smell and thermal effects, activated according to a trigger you choose. Touching the image or making a successful WIL save will reveal the illusion.

mapping.name: Perfect Preservation
mapping.description: A weapon you touch becomes immune to wear, mundane damage or elemental effects. The spell wears off after a day.

mapping.name: Phantom Hound
mapping.description: A ghostly canine (4 HP, bite (1d4)) obeys your commands for up to one hour.

mapping.name: Phase Anchor
mapping.description: Binds an extraplanar creature to your will until it performs a task specific task, after which they must pass a WIL save to escape (good luck).

mapping.name: Phase Sneak
mapping.description: Anyone within a 10ft radius is rendered invisible.

mapping.name: Phase Touch
mapping.description: A disembodied, floating hand obeys your whims but is immaterial. The next Spellbook, ability or item that relies on touch now works from a distance.

mapping.name: Philolomancy
mapping.description: You understand all spoken and written languages.

mapping.name: Philosopher's Mind
mapping.description: Target is immune to spiritual or psychic attacks, as well as any attempts at mental or spiritual manipulation or persuasion.

mapping.name: Planar Anchor
mapping.description: Bars extradimensional movement.

mapping.name: Plant Scourge
mapping.description: Plants within eyesight wither and die.

mapping.name: Pocket Container
mapping.description: Summons a chest from an immaterial plane. It holds up to 6 items. The chest is dismissed at will.

mapping.name: Pocket Sun
mapping.description: You create a halo of bright light in a 60ft radius.

mapping.name: Prisma Shard
mapping.description: An array of hypnotic lights fascinate nearby creatures, unless they pass a WIL save.

mapping.name: Profane Reveal
mapping.description: Target an empty space to reveal invisible objects or creatures.

mapping.name: Psychic Eye
mapping.description: Invisible floating eye allowing you to observe a single location as present.

mapping.name: Psychokinesis
mapping.description: Magically moves an object up to half your weight.

mapping.name: Puppeteer
mapping.description: You can throw your voice a great distance away

mapping.name: Purge Text
mapping.description: Mundane or magical writing vanishes at your touch.

mapping.name: Pyramid of Passivity
mapping.description: Target creatures must make a DEX save or their attacks are impaired.

mapping.name: Pyschic Touch
mapping.description: You can hear target's surface thoughts, so long as you touch them.

mapping.name: Rat-Tat-Tat
mapping.description: Loudly opens a locked or magically sealed door or chest.

mapping.name: Ravenless Message
mapping.description: You send a short message 1 mile that anyone along its path can hear.

mapping.name: Reject Unlife
mapping.description: Nearby undead are immobilized for 30 seconds or until you take another action.

mapping.name: Remembered Voice
mapping.description: A spot you mark becomes the trigger for a supernatural recording of your voice, delivering a short message of your choice.

mapping.name: Reverie
mapping.description: Targets become dazed for a moment, as if lost in daydream.

mapping.name: Runic Harm
mapping.description: A rune you draw causes great pain to the reader, who must WIL save or scream until they pass out (1d4 WIL loss). A successful save destroys the rune.

mapping.name: Runic Slumber
mapping.description: A rune you draw puts the reader into a magical sleep that lasts 1d6 hours.

mapping.name: Safe Haven
mapping.description: You summon a floating, invisible refuge for 8 hours. It fits up to 8 people comfortably.

mapping.name: Scintillate
mapping.description: Target must WIL save or their attacks become impaired.

mapping.name: Scry Creature
mapping.description: Indicates the precise location of a familiar creature.

mapping.name: Scry Object
mapping.description: Indicates the precise location of an object, known or otherwise.

mapping.name: Scrying Ward
mapping.description: For 24 hours you become aware of any magical eavesdropping.

mapping.name: Sculpt Water
mapping.description: Raise, lower or part nearby water.

mapping.name: Secret Attaché
mapping.description: You summon an invisible creature of great power that obeys your every command. Reading from other Spellbooks dispels the creature.

mapping.name: Shelter
mapping.description: Creates a standing edifice that can shelter up to 10 creatures, disappearing after 24 hours.

mapping.name: Shrinking Cant
mapping.description: A humanoid creature you touch halves in size.

mapping.name: Signal
mapping.description: Sends up a flare that can be seen for some distance.

mapping.name: Simple Illusion
mapping.description: Creates a simple image with sound. A cursory investigation will reveal the illusory image.

mapping.name: Sinister Flame
mapping.description: Target's palms are lined with flames (1d4+1 STR loss) for one minute.

mapping.name: Sinister Polymorph
mapping.description: WIL save or target is transformed into a harmless animal.

mapping.name: Skillfull Repair
mapping.description: You make minor repairs to a nonliving object.

mapping.name: Sky Raft
mapping.description: You summon a 3ft wide floating disk that holds up to 100lbs.

mapping.name: Solar Portal
mapping.description: Sends an extraplanar message to all beings that wish to enter your plane. You have no choice which being answers and it holds no loyalty to you or your allies.

mapping.name: Song of Repose
mapping.description: Target falls into a deep slumber.

mapping.name: Sonic Shattering
mapping.description: A sonic wave causes 1d6 STR loss to susceptible objects or crystalline creatures, ignoring armor.

mapping.name: Sorcerer's Lock
mapping.description: Any door (magical or otherwise) is held shut until you leave its vicinity.

mapping.name: Soul Annex
mapping.description: Target's spirit is caged within their body and replaced with the caster's. If the body is slain the original soul departs, but the caster must pass a WIL save to return to their body.

mapping.name: Steer's Strength
mapping.description: Target's strength triples; unarmed attacks are enhanced.

mapping.name: Strength Tap
mapping.description: A target you touch loses 1d6 STR, which is transferred to you (up to your max STR).

mapping.name: Stumbling Steps
mapping.description: A target you touch becomes deprived and loses 1 STR.

mapping.name: Stupefaction
mapping.description: Target temporarily loses sense of place and time. WIL save to overcome.

mapping.name: Sudden Slumber
mapping.description: Target falls asleep for 1d4 hours.

mapping.name: Summon Elemental
mapping.description: A being of fire, wire, earth, or wind manifests from available matter to perform a single task for the caster. It follows this command against its will.

mapping.name: Sway Will
mapping.description: A target is compelled to follow a stated course of action, without understanding why.

mapping.name: Temporary Reprieve
mapping.description: Target regains any lost STR, but loses it again after a few minutes.

mapping.name: Terrify
mapping.description: Targets within eyesight must pass a WIL save or flee.

mapping.name: Terrifying Illusion
mapping.description: A target is hunted by a terrible creature only they can see. Its attacks do 1d12 damage; on Critical Damage they must pass a WIL save or become catatonic.

mapping.name: Thief's Bane
mapping.description: An object appears trapped, even to an experienced thief.

mapping.name: Thwart the Elements
mapping.description: Damage from energy blasts are impaired against a target for the next hour.

mapping.name: Tongue of the Blue Serpent
mapping.description: Rust-colored, serpentine letters materialize on a surface you choose. Anyone reading these words becomes immobilized unless they succeed a WIL save.

mapping.name: Torrential Moat
mapping.description: You summon a powerful wind that deflects arrows, smaller creatures, and noxious gases.

mapping.name: Toxic Blast
mapping.description: A small orb of acid deals 1d6 blast damage to a target.

mapping.name: Transform Aura
mapping.description: Target's aura is made non-magical or vice-versa.

mapping.name: True Name
mapping.description: Determines the properties of a magical item you touch.

mapping.name: Trueshift
mapping.description: A willing target takes on a new form (keeping only their WIL), but must pass a WIL save to shift out.

mapping.name: Twilight Steed
mapping.description: Summons an arcane steed that never tires, but dissipates within daylight.

mapping.name: Ultimate Sacrifice
mapping.description: The book's holder transfer's their life force into a corpse, reviving both body and soul.

mapping.name: Uncurse
mapping.description: A person or object you touch is freed from a curse or nefarious spell.

mapping.name: Undefinable Target
mapping.description: An ally becomes immune to mundane ranged attacks for one round.

mapping.name: Undeniable Courage
mapping.description: Target passes next WIL save and their attacks are enhanced.

mapping.name: Unflappable Endurance
mapping.description: Target does not take Fatigue from non-magical activities or become deprived until their next rest.

mapping.name: Vermin Plague
mapping.description: Summons a swarm of bats, rats, spiders or similar creatures of your choice. They are harmless but distracting and hold no loyalty towards you or your allies.

mapping.name: Vines of Ichor
mapping.description: You spread sticky spiderwebs on the walls, floor and ceilings within a 20ft radius.

mapping.name: Warrior's Edge
mapping.description: Target weapon is enhanced, and victim automatically fails a critical damage save.

mapping.name: Windborn
mapping.description: You direct a powerful wind in a straight line, strong enough to blow over small boulders.

mapping.name: Winter's Woe
mapping.description: An icy storm assails multiple targets, obscuring visibility and making the ground icy and treacherous.

mapping.name: Witch Sight
mapping.description: Magical auras become visible to you for one hour.

mapping.name: Wizard's Exit
mapping.description: You and and anyone you touch can flee to safety at double speed.

mapping.name: Wizard's Grasp
mapping.description: You control a phantasmal hand that can lift up to 5 pounds.

mapping.name: Wizard's Haven
mapping.description: A small, walled-in area cannot be scryed.

mapping.name: Wizardsniff
mapping.description: You can feel any magic within a 60ft radius.

mapping.name: Word of Pain
mapping.description: A single phrase from your lips does 1d12 blast damage. Affected targets are also deafened.
